name: parser-expert
label: Parser Expert
description: Parse documents and extract data from PDFs, DOCX files, images, and webpages using Parser Expert's powerful API.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Parser Expert API key. You can find this in your dashboard under Integration -> New API Key.

get_extracted_data.label: Get Extracted Data
get_extracted_data.description: Retrieve the extracted data using the parser ID and bucket ID. The parser ID is returned when you upload a document.

parser_id.label: Parser ID
parser_id.description: The ID of the parser. This is returned when content is uploaded.

bucket_id.label: Bucket ID
bucket_id.description: The ID of the bucket where the data is stored.
